Add the opening title slide

Source: R/report_officer.R
report_title_slide.Rd

A one-line title slide, placed on the template's title layout (the one with a centre-title placeholder).

Usage

report_title_slide(doc, title, subtitle = NULL, layout = NULL, master = NULL)

Arguments

doc

A document from report_new().

title

Deck title.

subtitle

Optional strapline placed in the layout's subtitle placeholder – the respondent base and fieldwork period, say. NULL (default) leaves it empty.

layout, master

Optional overrides; NULL auto-selects the title layout.

Value

The updated document.

See also

report_slide(), report_section().

Other reporting: example_report(), list_report_templates(), report_add_plot(), report_add_slide(), report_add_table(), report_add_text(), report_deck(), report_layouts(), report_new(), report_save(), report_section(), report_slide(), scaffold_report()

Examples

doc <- report_new("pptx") %>%
  report_title_slide("Pod-Racing Fan Survey",
                     subtitle = "1,000 fans | Fieldwork 2026")
class(doc)
#> [1] "rpptx"
